description: SPECULATRON AI is a multidisciplinary team led by a licensed Mechanical Engineer with 18 years of industrial experience. For NASA Space Apps 2026, we're developing AegisμG, an AI-powered platform to analyze NASA's microgravity combustion research and advance spacecraft fire safety. We welcome innovators skilled in Python, AI/ML, data science, combustion physics, simulation, and visualization. Join us to transform scientific research into practical solutions for space exploration!
